Name: Ember (beta)
Author: Ember
Description: Lights, fan modes and live temperatures from Ember on your Stream Deck. Beta.

Actions.Name: Lighting scene
Actions.Tooltip: Tap: switch to the chosen scene. Hold: step to the next scene.

Actions.Name: Lights on/off
Actions.Tooltip: Turn Ember's lighting on or off.

Actions.Name: Brightness
Actions.Tooltip: Tap: one step brighter or dimmer. Hold: keep going.

Actions.Name: Cycle fan mode
Actions.Tooltip: Tap: next fan mode. Hold: previous fan mode.

Actions.Name: Open Ember
Actions.Tooltip: Open Ember, or start it if it is closed.

Actions.Name: Temperature or fan speed
Actions.Tooltip: Live CPU or GPU temperature or fan speed.
